name: python
description:
Run Python code in a persistent session (variables persist across calls; like a notebook). numpy is available as `np`. The network's weights are preloaded as float32 numpy arrays, both in the dict `weights` and as variables: W1[2, 1], b1[1]. W<k> has shape [in, out] (row = input unit). The network and environment cannot be run here except through these functions:
- save_weights: save_weights(params=None, **arrays) -> str. Save weight tensors (e.g. save_weights(W1=W1, b1=b1) or save_weights(weights)); only the given tensors are replaced. Budgeted functions use the saved weights.
- load_saved_weights: load_saved_weights() -> dict of the currently saved weight arrays.
- budget_status: budget_status() -> {name: {used, budget}}. Free.
- forward_pass: forward_pass(x: list of [x0, x1]) -> outputs of the SAVED network [budget: 2 calls]
stdout and the value of the last expression are returned (truncated to 20000 chars). Each call times out after 30s.

name: save_weights
description: Save network weights written as text. Full format: one line per row, `W1 row 3  -0.080 0.255 ...` (row = input unit) and `b1  0.1 -0.2 ...`. Sparse edits are applied on top of the currently saved weights: `W2[3,17] = 1.25`, `b1[4] = -0.5`, or a full replacement row `W2 row 3 <values>`.

text.description: Weights or edits in the format above.
